title: Capability Lease Gate — Audit Decision Record
description: One admit/deny decision emitted by ai-stack/switchboard/capability_lease_gate.py::enforce() for a single requested tool at the per-call admission chokepoint (Foundation C2). Observability contract only — the gate itself never blocks on this schema; a producer/consumer mismatch is a bug to fix in the producer, never a reason to widen this schema (additionalProperties:false is intentional).

ts.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ) of the decision.

tool.description: The requested tool name this decision applies to.

decision.description: Final admission verdict for this tool this call. 'deny' covers no-lease, expired, bad-signature, epoch-stale, zero-trust-strip, manifest mismatch, and gate-exception outcomes alike — see `reason` for which.

source.description: Which admission path produced the decision: an external candidate lease, a first-party manifest-issued lease, the S4 authority-unavailable degrade allowlist, or null when no path admitted the tool at all.

reason.description: Short machine-stable reason code, e.g. 'candidate-lease-verified', 'first-party-lease-verified', 'first-party-lease-epoch-stale', 'first-party-lease-bad-signature', 'lease-manifest-mismatch', 'zero-trust-strip', 'no-admitting-lease', 'first-party-manifest-bundle-mismatch', 'dev-key-authority-unavailable', 'epoch-source-unresolvable', or 'gate-exception:<ExceptionClassName>'.

degraded.description: True iff this decision was produced under the S4 authority-unavailable degrade (DEV-key or unresolvable epoch) rather than normal lease evaluation.

zero_trust_stripped.description: True iff this tool was dropped specifically because the request's zero_trust_behavior is 'strip' and the admitting lease's bound risk classification is write/network/exec-capable.

lease_id.description: The `lease_id` of the lease that admitted or was evaluated for this tool, or null when no lease was found (e.g. 'no-admitting-lease', degrade-path decisions, or a gate-internal exception).
